title: Graded cohomology image cycle presentation
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], K an integer-indexed cochain complex, L a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration], and p,n integers. Put A=L.complexStep p n, A'=L.complexStep (p+1) n as in [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], Z=ker(K.d n (n+1)) as the pullback of bottom, and B=im(K.d (n-1) n). Let I_n be the cohomology image filtration defined in [lem-sp-filtered-cohomology-image-finite]. The graded object gr^p I_n is isomorphic to the cokernel of the arrow of the pullback, along (A intersection Z).arrow, of (A intersection B)+(A' intersection Z). This is the quotient (A intersection Z)/((A intersection B)+(A' intersection Z)), with no finiteness or outer-tail hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 012Q, final displayed quotient calculation; Equation 12.24.5.2 in Tag 012P

proof.text: The cycles of L^p K identify with A intersection Z under its degree-n inclusion. Functoriality of homology identifies the image of their cycle projection in H^n(K) with I_n^p. The cycle projection onto H^n(L^p K) is epic, so its composite has the same image as the induced cohomology map.

The map from A intersection Z onto I_n^p has kernel A intersection B, since vanishing in ambient cohomology is precisely being an ambient boundary. The next filtration image I_n^(p+1) is similarly the image of A′ intersection Z. Thus the inverse image of that next image in A intersection Z is (A intersection B)+(A′ intersection Z). This sum is contained in A intersection Z by d squared zero and antitonicity, so pulling it back along the numerator arrow gives that kernel.

Compose the epic cycle map with the projection I_n^p onto its quotient by I_n^(p+1). The first isomorphism theorem identifies the cokernel of its kernel with that quotient, which is gradedPiece p of the image filtration.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomologyImage_graded_presentation
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} (L : DecreasingFiltration K) (p n : ℤ) :
  let A := L.complexStep p n
  let A' := L.complexStep (p + 1) n
  let Z := (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥
  let B := imageSubobject (K.d (n - 1) n)
  Nonempty ((L.cohomologyImage n).gradedPiece p ≅
    cokernel ((Subobject.pullback (A ⊓ Z).arrow).obj
      ((A ⊓ B) ⊔ (A' ⊓ Z))).arrow)
